page.overview:
Who is Skak Scar-Artist?

is a Goblin in service of Sauron created for Critical Role One-Shot: Shadow of War – Part 1 and 2. is played by Travis Willingham.

As a small and weak Goblin trying to survive in Greater Mordor, Skak has learned to use crossbows and alchemy experiments to defeat larger, more ferocious creatures. His magical abilities are flavored as alchemical devices.

As a 5th-level Arcane Trickster, Skak knows three wizard cantrips and four 1st-level spells from the wizard spell list.
